propositions: The binding_lifecycle.py absence-handling cluster (clear_absent, note_absent, note_absent_or_rekey) lacks integration-tier mutation oracles and is only pinned at unit tier.
An out-of-window-but-alive key cannot reach clear_absent through the existing idempotency fixture because all keys are seeded in-window, creating a structural blind spot in test coverage.
The bound-but-absent direct GET path uses a real backend whose 404s bypass the test harness fake transport, preventing reproduction of the absence-tracking flow at integration tier.
Integration tests must verify that clear_absent produces no mutations, no Jira writes, and does not modify updated_at when processing out-of-window keys.
The 404-to-alive roundtrip must be testable: note_absent records absence with a frozen clock sentinel, and clear_absent's clearing branch resets the absence counter.
